Pride and Progress Special Episode: Coverage of 1988 Republican and Democratic National Conventions – highlights: COMMERCIAL: The "Tyte" Party Line, for men only 1. History of gay rights movement. 2. On RNC floor, interviews with Evan Meecham, Al D'Amato, John Roberts, Jim Fenalson, Jonathan Bush, Henry Kissinger, and Marvin Bush, who are questioned about political issues affecting the gay community. 3. At DNC, interviews with Sgt. Perry Watkins, Karen Clark, Mike Farrell, Martin Hiraga, and Ted Weiss, who are questioned about political issues affecting the gay community. COMMERCIAL: Gay Pride Parade & Christopher Street Festival 1988 video 4. Interview with Urvashi Vaid. COMMERCIAL: 550-9000, presented by the Megaquest Group 5. NO/AIDS Task Force Resource Center discusses the AIDS crisis and progress. COMMERCIAL: 550-GAYS 6. Anti-gay followers of Pat Robertson harass gay rights activists at a gay rights rally at Lafayette Square. COMMERCIAL: The "Tyte" Party Line, for men only 7. RNC attendees react to ACTUP demonstration/counter-demonstration. COMMERCIAL: Village Pointe Condos 8. At the RNC, interview with Angela Buchanan who talks about children being taught about the "gay lifestyle". COMMERCIAL: 550-9000, presented by the Megaquest Group 9. At RNC, interviews with correspondents of non-gay news outlets. COMMERCIAL: 550-GAYS 10. At RNC, attendees discuss their support of George H.W. Bush; Urvashi Vaid discusses her opposition to Bush.
